name: Bajel Projects Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2022, Bajel Projects Ltd is in the business of Engineering, Procurement and Construction[1]Bajel Projects Limited (BPL) is a carved out legal entity from Bajaj Electricals Ltd. It's EPC segment comprises of Power Transmission & Power Distribution. BPL provides end to end solutions ranging from inhouse design, testing, procurement, manufacturing, installation & commissioning of the projects.
keyPoints:
Promoter Group
The company is a part of the Bajaj Group, India's third-largest group by market capitalization, operating in industries like Financial Services, Automobiles, Consumer Appliances, EPC, Steel, Insurance, Material Handling, Tours & Travels, etc, with a $167+ Bn market cap. It has 40+ group companies, 100,000+ employees, and a presence in 70+ countries. [1]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Debtor days have improved from 176 to 136 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 3.93 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.29.4 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
